pillars.quote: This research will impact the development of novel fire and smoke detection systems for the International Space Station and future spacecrafts.

measurements.quote: DAFT / DAFT-2 tests that a modified P-Trak particulate counter would be accurate in microgravity.
The modified P-Trak gathered data from counting aerosol particles and these data were compared to the DustTrak CNC specifically designed to work in microgravity.

objective_summary.value: The DAFT / DAFT-2 investigation aimed to verify that a modified TSI P-Trak particulate counter functions accurately in microgravity for quantifying smoke aerosols. It also sought to compare the modified P-Trak against a DustTrak control and analyze aerosol standards in microgravity.
objective_summary.quote: DAFT / DAFT-2 tests that a modified P-Trak particulate counter would be accurate in microgravity.

earth_applications.value: The successful adaptation of the TSI P-Trak for microgravity can guide the design of accurate smoke detection instruments for challenging Earth environments, such as submarines or underwater laboratories.
earth_applications.quote: Additionally, the successful adaptation of the TSI P-Trak for microgravity can inform the design of instruments for use in other challenging Earth environments, such as submarines or underwater laboratories where accurate detection of smoke can save lives.
